payload.name: Fluency-Truth Association
payload.fact: Information known to be true is experienced as easier to process than information known to be false.
payload.boundary: This association applies to believed truth status rather than objective truth.

provenance.title: Truth feels easy: Knowing information is true enhances experienced processing fluency
provenance.quote_or_locus: Participants in Experiment 1a judged true statements easier to read than false statements

provenance.title: Truth feels easy: Knowing information is true enhances experienced processing fluency
provenance.quote_or_locus: Experiment 1b thereby shows that it is not the actual truth or falsehood of information but the believed truth or falsehood that is associated with processing fluency

decision_note: NOT_TRANSFERABLE — the third-variable/reverse-causation critique of the illusory truth effect (truth causes fluency, not the reverse); a methodological caveat on illusory-truth-effect-fluency-based, not an independent actionable finding.
